Interface Question

All Known Implementing Classes:
Question.Binary, Question.Choice, Question.Score
@Experimental public sealed interface Question permits Question.Choice, Question.Binary, Question.Score
A typed question that a Classifier answers: a Question.Choice, a Question.Binary, or a Question.Score. Its instructions and criteria are ClassifierContent: text, or a JSON object or array.

The ADK object mapper (JsonBaseModel.getMapper()) reads and writes questions in Python ADK's JSON form, which names each kind in a type field.
